description: Domain boundary policy of MUSIC OS 360 consumed by domain-boundary-guardian, domain-boundary-reviewer and every operational agent: which entity owns which facts and what may never be shared or merged automatically.

entities.name: Project
entities.note: Completing a Project never registers a Work or a Phonogram; items go to their own module as pending registration.

entities.name: Work
entities.note: A material lyrics or authorship change is handled by the project rule for a new Work and never silently overwrites the original.

financeSeparation.companyFinance: income, expenses, payables and receivables of the company itself
financeSeparation.rule: External amounts are information and are never booked automatically as company income or expense; no agent or skill combines them in one total.

enforcement: domain-boundary-guardian blocks plans and diffs that merge entities
operational skills validate Work and Phonogram separately
reports keep company finance and external royalties in separate sections
